6029.title: Saved prompt stars disappear outside the active row
6029.rootCauseOneLine: The renderer applies zero opacity to every unselected star button, even when the prompt is already starred.
6029.proposedFix: Keep the star control visible when selected or starred; retain hover-only disclosure for other desktop rows.
6029.caveats: The second clean checkout repeats the focused DOM regression, not the browser run. Touch/no-hover devices already have a visibility override.
